title: Injective envelopes of partial C*-dynamical systems
summary: We extend Hamana's theory of injective envelopes, along with several key features of the theory, to the realm of partial C*-dynamical systems. In particular, we show that a partial C*-dynamical system has the ideal intersection property if and only if its injective envelope does. A key ingredient in our arguments is a new kind of unitization of a partial action on a unital C*-algebra $A$ arising from the C*-algebra generated by the orbits of $A$ in its injective envelope~$I(A)$.
